When several cards show fraud from the same device profile, the same billing region, or the same recipient email in one window, name the shared element, recommend `CREATE_CASE` and `FILE_REPORT`, and `MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS` for every card that shares it.

case.summary: Online transaction 3503878 ($99.92) on card C07987-K2 was flagged due to a high model score of 0.784 and risk score of 0.90. Investigation revealed that the transaction was conducted via a new device, D008254, which was also utilized within a 48-hour window for near-identical ~$100 purchases on cards C11309-K1 and C06224-K2. Connected card C06224-K2 is linked to confirmed fraud ring 37749036, and card C07987-K2 has three prior confirmed fraud cases. The activity is confirmed as coordinated card-not-present fraud, resulting in a card block, connected card monitoring, and a regulatory filing.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details an organized card-not-present fraud pattern involving customer C07987 and card C07987-K2, along with connected cards C06224-K2 and C11309-K1. On December 1, 2016, at 17:28:53 UTC, an unauthorized online transaction of $99.92 (transaction ID 3503878) was attempted on card C07987-K2 in billing region 264. The transaction originated from device D008254, identified as a Windows desktop running Chrome 61.0 with a 1280x720 display resolution, which was recorded as New for the cardholder. Graph analysis demonstrated that device D008254 was concurrently deployed across multiple accounts within a 48-hour window between November 29, 2016, and December 1, 2016. Specifically, device D008254 was used to execute transaction 3497738 ($100.06) on card C11309-K1 on November 29, 2016, and transaction 3503988 ($100.00) on card C06224-K2 on December 1, 2016, just 32 minutes after the subject transaction. All three transactions shared identical parameters, including the online channel, product category R, amounts of approximately $100, verizon.net payer email domains, and gmail.com recipient email domains. Furthermore, connected card C06224-K2 is an identified member of organized fraud ring 37749036, which encompasses 14 confirmed fraud cases, and card C07987-K2 has three confirmed fraud closed cases in its own history (CC-2011, CC-2860, CC-5026). Total unauthorized exposure on the subject card is $99.92, with aggregate activity across the connected cards totaling $299.98. Card C07987-K2 has been blocked to prevent further loss, connected cards have been scheduled for monitoring, and the institution is filing this report accordingly.
